scripts.db:schema: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$dbUrl = $env:DATABASE_URL; if (-not $dbUrl) { $line = Get-Content .env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^DATABASE_URL=' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($line) { $dbUrl = ($line -split '=',2)[1].Trim('"') } }; if (-not $dbUrl) { throw 'DATABASE_URL not found in shell env or .env' }; psql $dbUrl -f src/db/schema.sql"
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed
